$comment: Canonical MCP roster. build.mjs renders this into .mcp.json (Claude Code), the mcp block of opencode.json, and .cursor/mcp.json. Edit here only. profile 'default' ships in every generated config; 'opt-in' ships only with `node build.mjs --with <name>`.

github.why: /cr-run files issues and /cr-fix opens PRs. This server's OAuth does not support dynamic client registration, so the in-agent OAuth flow fails. Our panoply-gh bridge forwards to api.githubcopilot.com with GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN as Bearer and filters toolsets to issues,pull_requests,repos (44 tools -> 38).

context7.why: Version-accurate library docs. Cuts hallucinated APIs in /cr-fix on unfamiliar dependencies. Two tools, ~400 tokens, no auth - the cheapest server here.

playwright.why: Drives a real browser so /verify can check a web UI actually renders. Our panoply-browser wrapper pins the profile under ~/.panoply/browser, or hooks into a live Chrome/Edge with PANOPLY_BROWSER_CDP (--cdp-endpoint). ~21 tools (~5k tokens); worth it on repos with a front end.

showcase.why: Records screen captures of an agent session with ffmpeg and exports videos to a user-accessible folder. 5 tools, near-zero tokens; opt in when you want session recordings.

caveman.why: Gives the caveman-compression hook a real usage number instead of a heuristic. One tool, near-zero tokens; opt in if you want the hook to react to measured usage rather than guessing.

gh-cli.auth: gh auth session (reuse your existing gh login — no token needed)
gh-cli.why: The existing panoply-gh server is a thin bridge to the hosted GitHub MCP server, pinned to issues/pull_requests/repos — no Actions, no Projects. panoply-gh-cli wraps the local gh binary instead, so it covers the full CLI surface (Actions workflows + runs, Releases, Projects v2, labels, search) plus a gh_cli passthrough for anything not yet curated, all authenticated through your existing `gh auth` session.

opencode-bridge.auth: opencode CLI login (reuse your existing `opencode auth` session — no token needed)
opencode-bridge.why: Delegates prompts to your local opencode CLI as a tool (ask_opencode, list_opencode_models, zen_chat) with your own login and quota. Opt in when you want a second agent's loop, agents, or free-tier models inside the current session; 3 tools, zero deps.
